newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila okays capital hike of Chinabank.
newsitem.headline: Manila okays capital hike of Chinabank.

text.p: The Philippine central bank approved the capital increase of China Banking Corp to five billion pesos from 2.5 billion pesos, Chinabank said on Friday.

The central bank also allowed Chinabank to sell shares to foreigners up to the allowable limit. Under Philippine law, foreign entities can own up to 30 percent of the bank with approval from the Monetary Board of the central bank, and up to 40 percent, with approval from the president.
A Chinabank spokesman said the bank had no plans to invite foreign entities to invest in it, however. The capital increase will give the bank more flexibility, it said.
Chinabank is 8.0 percent-owned by the Taiwan-based International Commercial Bank of China.
